qa_pairs.question: What page can I find information about replacing the connecting rod on the BMW M3 S14Z engine?
qa_pairs.answer: Information about connecting rod replacement (piston removal) can be found on page 11-64.

qa_pairs.question: Where in the manual would I look to find procedures for timing chain replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Timing chain replacement procedures are located on page 11-70.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure number for valve clearance adjustment on the S14Z engine?
qa_pairs.answer: The procedure number for valve clearance adjustment is 11 34 004.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can I find the oil pump removal and installation procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil pump removal and installation procedures are on page 11-75.

qa_pairs.question: What procedure number corresponds to coolant thermostat removal and installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Coolant thermostat removal and installation has procedure number 11 53 000.

qa_pairs.question: Where would I find information about checking engine oil pressure?
qa_pairs.answer: Engine oil pressure check information can be found on page 11-75, under procedure 11 40 000.
